name: agentic-sdd
description: Spec-Driven Development lifecycle with slice-based TDD, E2E, visual QA, review, PR, triage, curation and ship. Lifecycle agents (spec, architect, planner, tdd, implement, e2e, qa, review, curate, refactor, cicd), stack-expert skills from one registry (React, React Native, Angular, Node/Express/Fastify, NestJS, Next.js, Remix / React Router 7, Django, FastAPI, Flask, C#/ASP.NET Core with StyleCop Analyzers, Avalonia, .NET MAUI, PostgreSQL, MongoDB), workflow skills, slash commands, and hooks that enforce the hard rules: role separation, no skipped/weakened tests, no gate bypass, gated commits. Cross-platform incl. macOS Apple Silicon.
